text: Oh, you got yourself a loom, how nice.

text: Honey, why did you get a loom?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I was working with luminous fish, and I thought, hey, loom! Mom, what are you doing here?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Because one of the great minds of the twenty- first century is raising glow- in- the- dark fish and weaving sarapes.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: This is not a sarape. This is a poncho. A sarape is open at the sides, a poncho is closed, this is a poncho, and neither is a reason to call someone's mother.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Really, when was the last time you left the house.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I went to the market with Penny.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well then buckle up, in the next four to eight days she's going to get very crabby.
